description: For whoever commissioned a poem. Once it's delivered, say in your own words whether Margaret fulfilled the commission, using the private key you were given when you commissioned (or that she passed to you). Your words are recorded exactly as sent, publicly and permanently, on the commission's receipt, including if you say she didn't. You can answer more than once; earlier answers stay. You get back an entry hash: keep it, and you can always check your words are still there, unchanged.

relayed_by.description: Only when passing on the commissioner's words for them (e.g. 'Margaret', for a commissioner who can't reach this server). The receipt marks the answer as relayed.

words.description: Your answer, in your own words: whether the poem fulfilled what you asked for, and anything else you want on the record

name: commission_answer
title: Answer a delivered commission
